agent_decisions_active_subject_idx.name: agent_decisions_active_subject_idx
agent_decisions_active_subject_idx.where: "agent_decisions"."status" <> 'superseded' and "agent_decisions"."revoked_at" is null and "agent_decisions"."tombstoned" = false and "agent_decisions"."injection_blocked" = false

agent_grounded_observations_source_shape.name: agent_grounded_observations_source_shape
agent_grounded_observations_source_shape.value: ("agent_grounded_observations"."origin_kind" = 'chat_user' and "agent_grounded_observations"."session_id" is not null and "agent_grounded_observations"."source_message_id" is not null and "agent_grounded_observations"."source_memory_id" is null) or ("agent_grounded_observations"."origin_kind" = 'memory_user' and "agent_grounded_observations"."source_memory_id" is not null and "agent_grounded_observations"."source_message_id" is null)

agent_memories_prompt_idx.name: agent_memories_prompt_idx
agent_memories_prompt_idx.where: "agent_memories"."status" = 'approved' and "agent_memories"."revoked_at" is null and "agent_memories"."tombstoned" = false and "agent_memories"."injection_blocked" = false

agent_memories_claim_hash_uniq.name: agent_memories_claim_hash_uniq
agent_memories_claim_hash_uniq.where: "agent_memories"."claim_hash" is not null and "agent_memories"."status" <> 'creating' and "agent_memories"."revoked_at" is null and "agent_memories"."tombstoned" = false

agent_memories_active_current_idx.name: agent_memories_active_current_idx
agent_memories_active_current_idx.where: "agent_memories"."status" not in ('creating', 'archived') and "agent_memories"."revoked_at" is null and "agent_memories"."tombstoned" = false and "agent_memories"."injection_blocked" = false

agent_memories_canonical_key_uniq.name: agent_memories_canonical_key_uniq
agent_memories_canonical_key_uniq.where: "agent_memories"."canonical_key" is not null and "agent_memories"."status" not in ('creating', 'archived') and "agent_memories"."revoked_at" is null and "agent_memories"."tombstoned" = false

agent_memories_current_version_shape_che.name: agent_memories_current_version_shape_check
agent_memories_current_version_shape_che.value: ("agent_memories"."status" = 'creating' and "agent_memories"."current_version_id" is null) or ("agent_memories"."status" <> 'creating' and "agent_memories"."current_version_id" is not null)

agent_memories_tombstone_shape_check.name: agent_memories_tombstone_shape_check
agent_memories_tombstone_shape_check.value: ("agent_memories"."tombstoned" = true and "agent_memories"."tombstoned_at" is not null) or ("agent_memories"."tombstoned" = false and "agent_memories"."tombstoned_at" is null)

agent_memory_candidates_content_shape_ch.name: agent_memory_candidates_content_shape_check
agent_memory_candidates_content_shape_ch.value: ("agent_memory_candidates"."gate_status" = 'accepted' and char_length("agent_memory_candidates"."content") between 1 and 2000) or ("agent_memory_candidates"."gate_status" in ('rejected', 'quarantined') and "agent_memory_candidates"."content" is null)

agent_scheduled_tasks_check.name: agent_scheduled_tasks_check
agent_scheduled_tasks_check.value: ("agent_scheduled_tasks"."schedule_type" = 'once' and "agent_scheduled_tasks"."run_at" is not null) or ("agent_scheduled_tasks"."schedule_type" = 'cron' and "agent_scheduled_tasks"."cron" is not null)

agent_skills_parent_shape.name: agent_skills_parent_shape
agent_skills_parent_shape.value: ("agent_skills"."type" = 'skill' and "agent_skills"."parent_id" is null) or ("agent_skills"."type" = 'reference' and "agent_skills"."parent_id" is not null)

agent_trace_events_terminal_shape_check.name: agent_trace_events_terminal_shape_check
agent_trace_events_terminal_shape_check.value: ("agent_trace_events"."event_type" = 'task_terminal_state' and "agent_trace_events"."terminal_status" is not null) or ("agent_trace_events"."event_type" <> 'task_terminal_state' and "agent_trace_events"."terminal_status" is null)
